title: Ukraine Holds Online Talks With US Envoys and European Leaders; Berlin Meeting Planned
detail: Ukraine held online talks on Nov 16 with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner and representatives of France, Germany, Britain, Italy and Poland. Zelenskyy called them 'not easy'; participants agreed to meet in Berlin with the Coalition of the Willing. Kushner said progress is being made but a final deal needs difficult decisions. Russian aide Yuri Ushakov said Moscow had not agreed to widen the talks and no date was set for the next round; Peskov said Russia wants lasting peace, not a temporary ceasefire.
